== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Lieutenant Cabbel (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]]. Compared with [[Lieutenant Cabbel (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013). The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
